cases.title: a block dated exactly five minutes ago gets a temporary vote
a block dated five minutes and a millisecond ago is refused
a block dated exactly five minutes ahead gets a temporary vote
a block dated five minutes and a millisecond ahead is refused
a permanent request on a block too old for a temporary vote gets a permanent vote
a quote shares the block window: exactly five minutes is quoted, a millisecond more is refused
a temporary vote is valid for five minutes and a permanent one until the end of January a thousand years on, each with a minute of slop
the bytes of a temporary vote seven minutes old do not parse
the bytes of a vote issued a minute ahead parse, and a millisecond further ahead do not
a second request for a block is refused while our temporary vote lives, its minute of slop included, and given once it has expired
a permanent request without our temporary vote is refused for that, however old its block
a stale block that overspends is refused for its balance before its age
a stale block whose sibling holds our permanent vote is refused for the sibling before its age
the other votes parse before the quote: a vote from the future is reported before an expired quote
